summary: Iteration 8 — full verification of the account-provisioning / password-hygiene / session-revocation rework. Backend regression: 146/146 pytest GREEN across backend_test.py + test_batches.py + test_iteration3.py + test_oos_disposition.py + the new test_auth_security.py (21 new tests) in 64s. Added an independent verification suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_verify.py (10 tests, all GREEN) that specifically exercises the eight review-request features against the live preview URL. Startup-no-reset: changed admin@lims.local password to a new value via /auth/change-password, ran `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, confirmed OLD password 'Admin@123' now returns 401 and the NEW password still authenticates 200 after the restart — no account was recreated (single admin row) and backend logs show no seeding output (only the standard uvicorn lifecycle; no seed/reset lines). Since an administrator exists, the startup 'no administrator' warning is (correctly) silent. Default-credential rejection: 'admin123','password','changeme','Admin123','Password1','admin' all rejected (401/429) for existing and unknown accounts. Source-code grep for Qa@12345 / Qc@12345 / Admin@123 / ADMIN_PASSWORD / admin123 / changeme / Password1 across /app/backend/*.py and /app/backend/.env returned zero hits. First-run provisioning: GET /api/auth/provisioning-status ⇒ {administrator_exists:true, first_run_available:false}; POST /api/auth/first-run returns 403 for both a strong password ('Str0ngP@ss123!') and a weak password ('abc') — admin-exists guard runs before password-length validation. Password exposure: login response, /auth/me, GET /users and POST /users bodies contain no 'password' or 'password_hash' fields; POST /users without a password returns temporary_password_issued:true and no value; audit endpoints checked contain no $2b$ / password_hash strings. Temporary-password flow: created test QC user via admin POST (temp issued, not returned) → admin PATCH sets a known temp → user login returns must_change_password:true → GET /api/samples ⇒ 403 with 'temporary password' in body → wrong current_password ⇒ 401 and old temp still logs in → correct change ⇒ 200, old temp now 401, new pw works, /samples now 200 (gate cleared). Authorisation: QA POST /users ⇒ 403, QA PATCH /users/{id}{role:'admin'} ⇒ 403, unauthenticated GET /users ⇒ 401. Session revocation: after /auth/logout the same bearer token ⇒ 401 and the captured refresh cookie replayed in a fresh session ⇒ 401; a successful /auth/refresh rotates the session so the pre-rotation refresh cookie ⇒ 401; changing admin password revoked 153 existing sessions in a single call (verified from response body). Deactivation: admin PATCH {active:false} on a logged-in test user immediately invalidates their existing session (GET /auth/me ⇒ 401) and blocks a fresh login (POST /auth/login ⇒ 403 inactive). UI: login page contains no demo credentials (grepped page HTML for the three emails and their passwords ⇒ all False; placeholders are generic 'you@lims.local' / dots). Admin login works, Users page lists users, role dropdown and Deactivate/Activate buttons render. A user with a temporary password sees the blocking dialog with all four expected data-testids: change-password-form, current-password-input, new-password-input, submit-change-password-btn; completing the dialog redirects to /login with a 'Password updated. Please sign in with your new password.' notice.

ui_bugs.issue: During the brief window between login-with-temporary-password and the gate mounting, the app fires background data fetches (dashboard etc.) that come back 403 'temporary password'. Axios rejections surface as CRA's red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay in the preview build (see screenshots change_pw_gate.png / after_change_pw.png). Only visible in the dev/preview overlay (won't appear in a production build), but should be handled: either delay data fetching until must_change_password is false, or swallow expected 403s from the temp-password gate in the axios interceptor.

action_items: Consider suppressing / handling the expected 403 'temporary password' responses from background API calls so the CRA runtime-error overlay does not appear behind the ChangePasswordGate dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: batches.py is now 1269 lines and server.py is 843 lines — both should be split into feature modules (auth, users, sessions, audit for server.py; routes/checks/coa/disposition for batches.py) to satisfy the 700-line file-size guideline (repeated from iter-6/7).
seed_users() only warns now — good. Consider also logging 'first_run_available=true' vs 'administrator_exists=true' at INFO on startup so operators can see the provisioning state at a glance.

PASSWORD_EXEMPT_PATHS is a tuple with prefix matching (startswith) — verify no future route accidentally shares a prefix, e.g. '/api/auth/me-admin' would inherit the exemption. A set with exact match would be safer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the eight required UI touch-points (demo creds removed, admin/qa/qc login still work, Users list/role/activate, ChangePasswordGate testids, post-change /login redirect)

test_credentials: admin@lims.local/Admin@123, qa@lims.local/Qa@12345, qc@lims.local/Qc@12345 (restored to originals after the restart-verification test).
seed_data_creation: Created and then deactivated three throwaway TEST_ users to exercise temp-password/deactivation flows; login_attempts collection cleared between tests. No changes to the three shared credentials remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Provisioning rework is fully verified end-to-end. If you re-run test_auth_security.py or test_iteration8_verify.py, use -n0 (single worker) and clear db.login_attempts between runs (a fixture already does this in the iter-8 file). PATCH /api/users/{id} with a password will set must_change_password=true and revoke that user's sessions — the iter-8 fixture also clears the flag on the three shared accounts. UserIn requires an 'initials' field (missed this initially — 422). UserUpdate uses 'active', not 'is_active'. Login response shape is {'user': {...}, 'access_token', 'must_change_password'} — no refresh_token in body (it is set only as an httpOnly cookie). The temp-password 403 fires on any non-exempt endpoint (PASSWORD_EXEMPT_PATHS = /api/auth/me, /api/auth/logout, /api/auth/change-password, /api/auth/refresh).
rca of the issue: N/A — all review-request behaviours pass. Only minor UX polish item is the CRA runtime-error overlay showing background 403s while the ChangePasswordGate is mounting.
